```{r hub, results='asis'}
sites <- CFG$sites$all
tb <- data.frame(Site = sprintf('[%s](site_%s.html)', sites, site_slug(sites)),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# one column per life stage: did that stage's curve pass the gate in 05?
if (exists('GATE') && !is.null(GATE) && 'stage' %in% names(GATE)) {
  g <- GATE[GATE$form == 'beta:fpc' & GATE$process == 'recruitment', ]
  for (stg in unique(g$stage)) tb[[stg]] <- vapply(sites, function(s) {
    v <- g[g$site == s & g$stage == stg, ]
    if (!nrow(v)) '_not run_' else
      sprintf('%s (%+.2f)%s', ifelse(v$passes[1], '**passes**', 'fails'), v$cv_gain[1],
              ifelse(isTRUE(v$ipm_selected[1]), ' *', '')) }, character(1))
}
kable(tb, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = 'One page per site. Gate result per life stage (CV gain over stock alone); * = the lag the IPM selected.')
```

The gate is what says whether a daily result means anything. A stage marked
**fails** still has figures — they are arithmetic, not findings.

The cross-site synthesis — what the daily curves say about brown trout
population ecology across Montana — is on the
**[Among sites](results_among_sites.html)** page.
